```{r}
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(VGAM)
library(broom)
library(gtsummary)
```

```{r}
w70 <- read_sav("ATP W70.sav")
w84 <- read_sav("ATP W84.sav")
```

```{r}
#| label: initial plots for presentation 1
df <- w70 %>% 
  select(ATTENDMONTH_W70,ATTENDONLINE_W70,F_RELIG,F_SEX,F_AGECAT)%>% 
  filter(if_all(everything(), ~ .x != 99)) %>% 
  filter(F_RELIG == 1|F_RELIG == 2)

df2 <- w84 %>%
  select(ATTENDMONTH_W84,ATTENDONLINE_W84,F_RELIG,F_GENDER,F_AGECAT)%>% 
  filter(if_all(everything(), ~ .x != 99)) %>% 
  filter(F_RELIG == 1|F_RELIG == 2)


#Attend form VS Religion ONLINE (WAVE70)
ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(F_RELIG), fill = factor(ATTENDONLINE_W70))) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = after_stat(count)),          
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Respondents Attending Online Worship by Religion(July 2020)",
    x = "Religious Group",
    y = "Number of People",
    fill = "Attended Online"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("1" = "Protestant", "2" = "Roman Catholic")) +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("1" = "Yes", "2" = "No")) +   # 👈 这一行
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
w70_cp <- w70 %>%
  filter(F_RELIG %in% c(1,2))%>%
  filter(ATTENDMONTH_W70 != 99, ATTENDONLINE_W70 != 99)
w70_cp %>%
  group_by(ATTENDMONTH_W70) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_month = mean(ATTENDMONTH_W70, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_month = sd(ATTENDMONTH_W70, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

w70_cp %>%
  group_by(ATTENDONLINE_W70) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_month = mean(ATTENDONLINE_W70, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_month = sd(ATTENDONLINE_W70, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```

```{r}

#| label: create respond variable attend

library(nnet)
w70_cp <- w70 %>% 
  filter(F_RELIG %in% c(1,2)) %>% 
  filter(ATTENDMONTH_W70 != 99, ATTENDONLINE_W70 != 99) %>%
  mutate(attend = case_when(
    ATTENDMONTH_W70 == 1 & ATTENDONLINE_W70 == 1 ~ "Both",
    ATTENDMONTH_W70 == 1 & ATTENDONLINE_W70 == 2 ~ "In-person only",
    ATTENDMONTH_W70 == 2 & ATTENDONLINE_W70 == 1 ~ "Online only",
    ATTENDMONTH_W70 == 2 & ATTENDONLINE_W70 == 2 ~ "Neither"
  )) %>%
  mutate(attend = factor(attend, 
                         levels = c("In-person only", "Online only", "Both", "Neither")))
w70_cp$attend <- relevel(w70_cp$attend, ref = "In-person only")
table(w70_cp$attend)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# ATTENDMONTH_W70 = attend mass in person
# ATTENDONLINE_W70 = attend mass online
#
# attend codes:
# 1 -> attend in person = 1, online = 1  (attend both)
# 2 -> attend in person = 1, online = 2  (only in person)
# 3 -> attend in person = 2, online = 1  (only online)
# 4 -> attend in person = 2, online = 2  (attend neither)
#
# Note: rows with v1 == 99 or v2 == 99 are removed
# ------------------------------------------------------------

```

```{r}
attend_counts <- w70_cp %>%
  count(attend)

# 绘图
ggplot(attend_counts, aes(x = attend, y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.3, size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Attendance Patterns",
    x = "Attendance Type",
    y = "Number of Respondents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
#| label: Hypothesis 1

# Step 1: 清除含有 99 的观测
w70_cp_clean <- w70_cp %>%
  filter(if_all(c(
    ATTENDCONF_W70, COVIDCONG3_W70, COVIDCONG4_W70,
    CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70, CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70, CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70,
    CTKNOW1_W70, CONTACTTRAC1_W70,
    SERMONISSUE_a_W70, SERMONISSUE_b_W70, SERMONISSUE_c_W70,
    SERMONISSUE_d_W70, SERMONISSUE_e_W70, SERMONISSUE_f_W70
  ), ~ . != 99))

# Step 2: 转为 factor
w70_cp_clean <- w70_cp_clean %>%
  mutate(across(c(
    ATTENDCONF_W70, COVIDCONG3_W70, COVIDCONG4_W70,
    CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70, CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70, CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70,
    CTKNOW1_W70, CONTACTTRAC1_W70,
    SERMONISSUE_a_W70, SERMONISSUE_b_W70, SERMONISSUE_c_W70,
    SERMONISSUE_d_W70, SERMONISSUE_e_W70, SERMONISSUE_f_W70
  ), as.factor))

# Step 3: 设置 reference 类别
w70_cp_clean$attend <- relevel(w70_cp_clean$attend, ref = "In-person only")

# Step 4: 自动检测并移除只有一个水平的变量
vars_h1 <- c(
  "ATTENDCONF_W70", "COVIDCONG3_W70", "COVIDCONG4_W70",
  "CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70", "CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70", "CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70",
  "CTKNOW1_W70", "CONTACTTRAC1_W70",
  "SERMONISSUE_a_W70", "SERMONISSUE_b_W70", "SERMONISSUE_c_W70",
  "SERMONISSUE_d_W70", "SERMONISSUE_e_W70", "SERMONISSUE_f_W70"
)

# 检查每个变量的水平数
level_counts <- sapply(w70_cp_clean[, vars_h1], nlevels)
invalid_vars <- names(level_counts[level_counts <= 1])

if (length(invalid_vars) > 0) {
  message("⚠️ 以下变量只有一个水平，被自动移除: ", paste(invalid_vars, collapse = ", "))
}

valid_vars <- setdiff(vars_h1, invalid_vars)

# Step 5: 动态建立 formula
formula_h1 <- as.formula(paste("attend ~", paste(valid_vars, collapse = " + ")))

# Step 6: 拟合模型
model_h1 <- multinom(formula_h1, data = w70_cp_clean)

# Step 7: 输出 summary 与显著性
summary(model_h1)

# check p-values to find statstical significant variables
tidy(model_h1, conf.int = TRUE) %>% print(n = 42)
```

```{r}
#| label: predictor table for h1 w70

library(dplyr)
library(nnet)
library(gtsummary)

w70_h1 <- w70_cp_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # 1️⃣ 出席信心
    ATTENDCONF_W70 = factor(
      ATTENDCONF_W70,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
      labels = c("Very confident",
                 "Somewhat confident",
                 "Not too confident",
                 "Not at all confident")
    ),

    # 2️⃣ 教会防疫行动
    COVIDCONG3_W70 = factor(
      COVIDCONG3_W70,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
      labels = c("No actions",
                 "Some actions",
                 "Many actions",
                 "Extensive actions")
    ),

    # 3️⃣ 教会限制措施
    CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70 = factor(
      CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
      labels = c("No restrictions",
                 "Minor restrictions",
                 "Major restrictions",
                 "Severe restrictions")
    ),

    # 4️⃣ 接触追踪
    CONTACTTRAC1_W70 = factor(
      CONTACTTRAC1_W70,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Support contact tracing",
                 "Do not support")
    ),

    # 5️⃣ 布道主题 c: COVID 防控
    SERMONISSUE_c_W70 = factor(
      SERMONISSUE_c_W70,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Heard sermons on limiting COVID spread",
                 "Did not hear such sermons")
    ),

    # 6️⃣ 布道主题 f: 其他议题
    SERMONISSUE_f_W70 = factor(
      SERMONISSUE_f_W70,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Heard sermons on other topics",
                 "Did not hear such sermons")
    ) 
  )

#set "did not hear" as reference 
w70_h1$SERMONISSUE_c_W70 <- relevel(
  w70_h1$SERMONISSUE_c_W70,
  ref = "Did not hear such sermons"
)
w70_h1$SERMONISSUE_f_W70 <- relevel(
  w70_h1$SERMONISSUE_f_W70,
  ref = "Did not hear such sermons"
)
w70_h1$CONTACTTRAC1_W70 <- relevel(
  w70_h1$CONTACTTRAC1_W70,
  ref = "Do not support"
)

model_h1_sub <- multinom(
  attend ~ ATTENDCONF_W70 + COVIDCONG3_W70 +
    CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70 + CONTACTTRAC1_W70 +
    SERMONISSUE_c_W70 + SERMONISSUE_f_W70,
  data = w70_h1
)

tbl_regression(
  model_h1_sub,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  label = list(
    ATTENDCONF_W70 ~ "Confidence in attending safely",
    COVIDCONG3_W70 ~ "Congregation’s COVID safety actions",
    CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70 ~ "Congregational restrictions",
    CONTACTTRAC1_W70 ~ "Contact tracing support",
    SERMONISSUE_c_W70 ~ "Sermon topic: limiting COVID spread",
    SERMONISSUE_f_W70 ~ "Sermon topic: other issues"
  )
) %>%
```

```{r}
w84_cp <- w84 %>% 
  filter(F_RELIG %in% c(1,2)) %>% 
  filter(ATTENDMONTH_W84 != 99, ATTENDONLINE_W84 != 99) %>%
  mutate(attend = case_when(
    ATTENDMONTH_W84 == 1 & ATTENDONLINE_W84 == 1 ~ "Both",
    ATTENDMONTH_W84 == 1 & ATTENDONLINE_W84 == 2 ~ "In-person only",
    ATTENDMONTH_W84 == 2 & ATTENDONLINE_W84 == 1 ~ "Online only",
    ATTENDMONTH_W84 == 2 & ATTENDONLINE_W84 == 2 ~ "Neither"
  )) %>%
  mutate(attend = factor(attend, 
                         levels = c("In-person only", "Online only", "Both", "Neither")))
w84_cp$attend <- relevel(w84_cp$attend, ref = "In-person only")
```

```{r}
#| label: predictor table for h1 w84

library(dplyr)
library(nnet)
library(gtsummary)

# Step 1: 构建 w84_h1 数据集并添加 labels
w84_h1 <- w84_cp_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # 1️⃣ 感知严重性（COVID severity）
    COVIDSPIR_W84 = factor(
      COVIDSPIR_W84,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 99),
      labels = c(
        "Stronger",
        "Weaker",
        "No change",
        "Not religious",
        "Refused"
      )
    ),

    # 2️⃣ 目前教会开放状态（perceived susceptibility proxy）
    COVIDCONG3_W84 = factor(
      COVIDCONG3_W84,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 99),
      labels = c(
        "Open as before COVID",
        "Open but with changes",
        "Closed to in-person services",
        "Not sure",
        "Refused"
      )
    ),

    # 3️⃣ 认为教会应该开放的状态（behavioral susceptibility）
    COVIDCONG4_W84 = factor(
      COVIDCONG4_W84,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 99),
      labels = c(
        "Open as before COVID",
        "Open but with changes",
        "Closed to in-person services",
        "Refused"
      )
    )
  )

# Step 2: 设置 reference levels（选最不觉得 COVID 危险的作为 baseline）
w84_h1$attend <- relevel(w84_h1$attend, ref = "In-person only")

w84_h1$COVIDSPIR_W84 <- relevel(
  w84_h1$COVIDSPIR_W84,
  ref = "No change"
)

w84_h1$COVIDCONG3_W84 <- relevel(
  w84_h1$COVIDCONG3_W84,
  ref = "Open as before COVID"
)

w84_h1$COVIDCONG4_W84 <- relevel(
  w84_h1$COVIDCONG4_W84,
  ref = "Open as before COVID"
)

# Step 3: Multinomial logistic regression
model_w84_h1 <- multinom(
  attend ~ COVIDSPIR_W84 + COVIDCONG3_W84 + COVIDCONG4_W84,
  data = w84_h1
)

# Step 4: gtsummary 输出（与 W70 样式一致）
tbl_regression(
  model_w84_h1,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  label = list(
    COVIDSPIR_W84 ~ "Perceived severity of COVID-19",
    COVIDCONG3_W84 ~ "Current operating status of house of worship",
    COVIDCONG4_W84 ~ "Preferred operating status of house of worship"
  )
) %>%
  modify_caption("**Wave 84 – Predictors of Online and Hybrid Attendance (Susceptibility & Severity)**") %>%
  bold_labels()


```

```{r}
    COVIDSPIR_W84 ~ "Perceived severity of COVID-19"
  )
) %>%
  modify_caption("**Wave 84 – Predictors of Online and Hybrid Attendance (H2: COVID Severity)**") %>%
  bold_labels()
```

```{r}
    ESTR21_W84 = factor(
      ESTR21_W84,
      levels = c(1, 2, 99),
      labels = c(
        "Yes – plans in-person Easter",
        "No – does not plan in-person Easter",
        "Refused"
      )
    ),

    # 2️⃣ 通常是否线下参加复活节（宗教习惯）
    ESTRTYP_W84 = factor(
      ESTRTYP_W84,
      levels = c(1, 2, 99),
      labels = c(
        "Yes – normally attends in-person Easter",
        "No – does not normally attend Easter",
        "Refused"
      )
    )
  )

# Step 2: baseline settings
w84_h3$attend <- relevel(w84_h3$attend, ref = "In-person only")

# 每个变量的 baseline = “No”（数字经验较低的组）
w84_h3$ESTR21_W84 <- relevel(
  w84_h3$ESTR21_W84,
  ref = "No – does not plan in-person Easter"
)

w84_h3$ESTRTYP_W84 <- relevel(
  w84_h3$ESTRTYP_W84,
  ref = "No – does not normally attend Easter"
)

# Step 3: Multinomial model
model_w84_h3 <- multinom(
  attend ~ ESTR21_W84 + ESTRTYP_W84,
  data = w84_h3
)

# Step 4: gtsummary table
tbl_regression(
  model_w84_h3,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  label = list(
    ESTR21_W84 ~ "Plans to attend in-person Easter",
    ESTRTYP_W84 ~ "Normally attends in-person Easter"
  )
) %>%
  modify_caption("**Wave 84 – H3: Self-Efficacy / Digital Religious Experience**") %>%
  bold_labels()
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# H5: Structural Barriers (Wave 84)
# =========================================================

# Step 1: 清理含有 99 的观测
w84_h5_clean <- w84_cp %>%
  filter(if_all(c(
    COVIDCONG3_W84,
    CONGRESTRICT1_c_W84,
    CONGRESTRICT1_b_W84
  ), ~ . != 99))

# Step 2: 转为因子
w84_h5_clean <- w84_h5_clean %>%
  mutate(across(c(
    COVIDCONG3_W84,
    CONGRESTRICT1_c_W84,
    CONGRESTRICT1_b_W84
  ), as.factor))

# Step 3: 设置 reference 类别
w84_h5_clean$attend <- relevel(w84_h5_clean$attend, ref = "In-person only")

# Step 4: 自动检测并移除只有一个水平的变量
vars_h5 <- c(
  "COVIDCONG3_W84",
  "CONGRESTRICT1_c_W84",
  "CONGRESTRICT1_b_W84"
)

level_counts_h5 <- sapply(w84_h5_clean[, vars_h5], nlevels)
invalid_vars_h5 <- names(level_counts_h5[level_counts_h5 <= 1])

if (length(invalid_vars_h5) > 0) {
  message("⚠️ 以下变量只有一个水平，被自动移除: ",
          paste(invalid_vars_h5, collapse = ", "))
}

valid_vars_h5 <- setdiff(vars_h5, invalid_vars_h5)

# Step 5: 动态 formula
formula_h5 <- as.formula(
  paste("attend ~", paste(valid_vars_h5, collapse = " + "))
)

# Step 6: 拟合多项逻辑回归
model_h5 <- multinom(formula_h5, data = w84_h5_clean)

# Step 7: 输出 coef + p-values
summary(model_h5)

z_h5 <- summary(model_h5)$coefficients / summary(model_h5)$standard.errors
p_h5 <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_h5)))

round(p_h5, 4)

```
